sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id AND b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'h'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';
